set.body:
Outcome: shared acceptance contract for GitHub issues #9, #10, #11 at baseline fc2d34e405f0b73cb9bd41c69432845000698d32. Planning only so far; implementation is future work.
Scope: reusable feature-library outputs; scanner alignment, HRF/TR pooling, dimensionality reduction, model training and All-In-One integration remain outside this work.
Proposed change: reuse FeatureSeries, TimebaseSpec/SupportSpec, TemporalContext clock mappings and typed backend errors. Define a small validated, versioned metadata record for intrinsic computation context, separate from observation support and clock mappings. Record context clock, supplied input extent, bidirectional/past-only policy, preprocessing dependencies, and per-chunk dependency extents when applicable. Keep absolute provenance bounds explicitly tied to their source clock so in_clock cannot silently relabel them. Verify storage and temporal_payload preservation.
Identity must include resolved immutable checkpoint/code revision or local asset digest, preprocessing, layer selection, parameters and backend version. Ensure recipe/cache identities cannot reuse outputs across changed assets. No silent resampling, dimension reduction, heuristic substitution or network access.
Relevant paths: src/natural_features/core/{feature_types,timebase,feature_bundle,recipe}.py; features/common.py; core/backend_errors.py; docs/spec/native-temporal-contract.qmd. Prefer narrow helpers/metadata over a global schema migration; only touch core conversion/storage if evidence requires it.
Acceptance: direct calls and recipes preserve nondefault clock, offset, mappings, axes and support; clock conversion and NPZ/Zarr/Parquet round trips retain unambiguous context; changing assets or layers changes identity. Proposed tests/unit/test_music_temporal_contract.py plus existing test_temporal_contract.py and test_temporal_storage_roundtrip.py.
Next action: write contract fixtures and settle sample-center versus half-open support convention before backend implementation.
set.title: Music features: define native timing, model context, and asset identity contracts
